nodes.goal:
Add job cancellation, automatic retries for failed jobs, and recovery after a process restart to this job runner. Expose cancellation and retry status through the REST API and show them on the web dashboard. Follow the behaviour specified in SPEC.md.

Work through the following steps in order; each step lists its goal and files.

Step 1 of 7: Contract: states, job fields, errors, cancel signature [A]
This is the contract every other sub-task builds on; follow SPEC.md for names, types, and defaults. Give each new name a docstring. In jobrunner/models.py add JobStatus.CANCELLED (final) and the Job fields attempts=0, max_attempts=3, next_run_at=0.0, last_error=None, cancel_requested=False, and include them in Job.to_dict. In jobrunner/errors.py add TransientError and InvalidTransition. In jobrunner/store.py keep the new fields of saved jobs in an in-memory dict so get/list return them within one JobStore object (persistence comes later). In jobrunner/runner.py make submit set max_attempts and next_run_at, and add Runner.cancel(job_id) -> Job: PENDING becomes CANCELLED, RUNNING gets cancel_requested=True, a final job raises InvalidTransition, an unknown id raises JobNotFound. Do not implement retries, recovery, or the handling of cancel_requested after a run. Write tests/test_contract.py for these names and defaults.
Modify: jobrunner/models.py, jobrunner/errors.py, jobrunner/store.py, jobrunner/runner.py
Tests to write: tests/test_contract.py

Step 2 of 7: Persist job progress in SQLite [B]
Make jobrunner/store.py persist attempts, max_attempts, next_run_at, last_error, and cancel_requested in the jobs table (add the columns, migrating an existing table) and read them back in get and list, replacing the in-memory fields from the contract. A new JobStore on the same file must see every field (SPEC.md 'Restart recovery'). Write tests/test_persistence.py.
Modify: jobrunner/store.py
Tests to write: tests/test_persistence.py

Step 3 of 7: Retries and restart recovery in the runner queue [C]
Retries and restart recovery share the runner's re-queue logic, so implement both in jobrunner/runner.py. Count an attempt when a job starts; order the queue by next_run_at then id and only run due jobs; on TransientError apply SPEC.md 'Retries' (back to PENDING with next_run_at = now + base_delay * 2 ** (n - 1), or FAILED); any other Exception fails at once; record last_error. In Runner.__init__ recover RUNNING jobs per SPEC.md 'Restart recovery' (CANCELLED if cancel_requested, otherwise one failure) and re-queue pending jobs. Change _enqueue and run_once for this. Write tests/test_retry_recovery.py; within one JobStore object the progress fields are available before persistence lands.
Modify: jobrunner/runner.py
Tests to write: tests/test_retry_recovery.py

Step 4 of 7: Cancellation of running jobs [D]
Complete cancellation in jobrunner/runner.py per SPEC.md 'Cancellation': after a handler finishes, if the job's stored cancel_requested is set (it may have been set while the handler ran), the job becomes CANCELLED, its result is discarded, and it is not retried even after a TransientError. Pending jobs that were cancelled, including ones waiting for a retry, must never run. Write tests/test_cancel.py.
Modify: jobrunner/runner.py
Tests to write: tests/test_cancel.py

Step 5 of 7: REST API for cancellation and retry status [E]
Extend jobrunner/api.py as SPEC.md 'REST API' requires: add POST /jobs/<id>/cancel (200 with the job, 404 for an unknown id, 409 when Runner.cancel raises InvalidTransition) and make sure job JSON (Job.to_dict) includes attempts, max_attempts, next_run_at, last_error, and cancel_requested. Keep the existing routes and error format. Write tests/test_api_status.py covering the new route and fields.
Modify: jobrunner/api.py
Tests to write: tests/test_api_status.py

Step 6 of 7: Dashboard columns and cancel form [F]
Change jobrunner/dashboard.py render_jobs as SPEC.md 'Dashboard' requires: columns ID, Kind, Status, Attempts (attempts/max_attempts), Next retry (next_run_at with one decimal for a PENDING job with attempts > 0, otherwise '-'), and Actions (the cancel form for PENDING and RUNNING jobs, empty otherwise). Keep HTML escaping. Write tests/test_dashboard_status.py.
Modify: jobrunner/dashboard.py
Tests to write: tests/test_dashboard_status.py

Step 7 of 7: Integration and end-to-end tests [G]
Write tests/test_end_to_end.py exercising SPEC.md end to end through the REST API and the dashboard: flaky jobs retried to success, cancellation of pending and running jobs, and a restart (a new JobStore and Runner on the same database file) recovering waiting and interrupted jobs. Fix any mismatch between modules that these tests reveal.
Modify: jobrunner/store.py, jobrunner/runner.py, jobrunner/api.py, jobrunner/dashboard.py
Tests to write: tests/test_end_to_end.py
